verdict.rationale: Expensify's AI marketing says users can "build rules" by just asking (expensify-docs-4). Its QuickBooks Online connection automatically exports finalized reports (expensify-docs-7), which is an event-triggered automatic action. The evidence never describes what user-defined rules can do, what events they respond to, or what actions they fire. missing for 10: documentation of a user-defined rule engine (trigger conditions, event types, configurable actions), examples of custom event→action rules beyond fixed integration exports, independent or hands-on corroboration.
